name: ObjectivesComponentServerFacet_UpdateTrackedObjectives
summary: The client's tracked-objectives update: the shared 16-byte head (two u64 BE) then a prefix-varint count (<= 8) and that many u64 BE tracked-objective ids. 17..81 byte body, C2S. Live channel-0 records match the writer/reader layout field for field.
purpose: Tell the server which objectives the player is tracking. The server changes the objectives replicated state; the Objectives family has no reply for this request.

created_when: the player tracks, untracks, or reorders a tracked objective in the journal
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the tracked-objective set and cannot replay it

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint b2 16, i.e. type_dec 1458. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: local_facet_id
fields.note: First u64 of the shared message head, and the sending facet's own local id - identity, not request data. The send builder fills msg+0x08 from FUN_1416c1c40(facet) = *[*[facet+8]+8] + [GDE+0x10]: [GDE+0x10] is the id handed out by the global id dispenser FUN_14144a9f0 at ClientGDE attach (writer FUN_141464890 <- FUN_14167c760), and *[*[facet+8]+8] is a base read off the object the GDE's server-GDE reference resolves to (FUN_1417db510). That same value is the key the facet registers itself under in the Context's facet map (FUN_14167c560: key FUN_1416c1c40(facet), value the facet object, slot array at Context+0x1b0) and the key the RMI dispatcher looks up, so it is the local id the server must address. The client names it itself: log field facetId, 'Failed to unregister the facet.', and on a duplicate collidingLocalId + collidingFacetName with 'We got a collision on facets IDs, RMIs may fail to be delivered to this facet.'; the dispatch failure line calls it targetLocalId. Measured 0x180f8d4e573697c6 in the live 0x5b2 bodies, the same value its 0xa95 sibling carries - one per facet, not per message.

fields.name: local_actor_id_word0
fields.note: Second u64 of the shared message head, and the first 8 bytes of the client's own actor id - identity, not request data. Writer FUN_1414dbca0 copies the message object's +0x10 through a stack local and writes it big-endian (htonl64 FUN_1461668a0) through the stream raw-write slot +0x40. The send builder fills +0x10 from FUN_1416be9f0, which dereferences the weak handle at the GDE's +0x60 (FUN_14165c230) and reads [session+0x88]. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in all 14 committed bodies of the six head-prefixed messages across five sessions; in the same records its little-endian bytes 1a954abc4b3185bf are the first 8 of the record's 16-byte actor id, the local player's actor id handed over by ClientAddEntryMsg (0xa4).

fields.name: tracked_objective_ids
fields.note: Prefix-varint count (stated <= 8) then count x u64 BE. meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0x5b2: 'head + varint(len <= 8) + N u64 BE'. Live bodies show count 0 (17-byte body) and count 6 (65-byte body).

evidence.ref: Head provenance, recovered 2026-11-01: the shared writer FUN_1414dbca0 stores msg+0x08 (straight) then msg+0x10 (through a stack local) with FUN_140877280 = htonl64 FUN_1461668a0 + stream raw-write slot +0x40; the reader FUN_14150e670 mirrors it. This wire's builder FUN_143a06ec0 fills +0x08 with FUN_1416c1c40(...) and +0x10 with *FUN_1416be9f0(...) = [session+0x88]
